_comment: Output of the route-verification pass, 2026-07-31. Each entry was checked against a source independent of the Wikipedia KKIA table (the other endpoint's airport article, an airline's own booking engine or network release, AeroRoutes, or a schedule aggregator). 'add' = restore to the map; 'drop' = remove from the map; 'note' = keep but qualify.

ADE.why: Aden airport's own Wikipedia destination table lists Yemenia to Riyadh; Anadolu Agency (4 Jan 2026) quotes Yemenia's deputy GM naming Riyadh among four Aden destinations; FlightConnections Yemenia route map updated 2 Jul 2026.

CMB.why: Bandaranaike (CMB) destination table lists SriLankan to Riyadh with no qualifier; FlightConnections (31 Jul 2026) names SriLankan the only nonstop operator; UL265/UL266 A330-300.

CNN.why: Air India Express's own booking site lists Kannur from Riyadh; Kannur airport article lists it; Kerala press reports international services resumed 1 Jul 2026 with 3 weekly to Riyadh.

EJH.why: Al-Wajh Domestic Airport article (edited 7 Jul 2026) lists 'Saudia | Jeddah, Riyadh'; FlightConnections shows RUH 13 flights/month on SV.

MUX.why: FlightConnections lists PIA as nonstop operator RUH-MUX.

TBS.why: FlightConnections lists flynas nonstop RUH-TBS; flynas Summer 2026 network release includes Tbilisi.

BUS.why: Batumi Airport's own route map lists 'Flynas | Riyadh'; FlightConnections (31 Jul 2026) names flynas the only operator, 6 weekly.

SZG.why: FlightConnections RUH-SZG; flynas Summer 2026 network release includes Salzburg.

TIA.why: FlightConnections RUH-TIA; flynas Summer 2026 network release includes Tirana.

BUD.why: flynas own media-centre Summer 2026 network release lists Budapest among new Riyadh routes.

TGD.why: flynas Summer 2026 network release (via TradeArabia) lists Podgorica; single source, not yet corroborated by the airport's own listing.

DMK.why: Bangkok-Don Mueang was served only by Thai AirAsia X, which extended its suspension, removed schedule filings for 01OCT26-24OCT26 and filed no resumption date (AeroRoutes, 30 Jul 2026). Bangkok is still on the map via Suvarnabhumi (BKK/Saudia).

LCA.why: FlightConnections: no direct Riyadh-Larnaca flights; Larnaca airport's own destination table does not list Riyadh; flyadeal's published Summer 2026 seasonal network (Milan, Prague, Trabzon, Sarajevo, Sharm El Sheikh) omits it. Checked at peak season, when a live seasonal route would be visible.

AMS.why: KLM is the only Riyadh-Amsterdam operator and has suspended the route until 6 September 2026 amid regional airspace disruption (The National, 26 Jul 2026). Kept on the map and flagged, because it is a suspension with a stated return date, not a cancellation.

CGK.why: Garuda's Riyadh service is marked terminated; the remaining Jakarta service is Saudia's seasonal Hajj/Umrah operation. Kept as seasonal at low confidence.

_excluded._comment: Checked and deliberately left off the map. Recorded so the omissions are visible rather than silent.
_excluded.ADB: Izmir - Saudia last flew 2018, flyadeal 2023; no Saudi point in Izmir's 94 nonstop destinations (FlightConnections, Jul 2026). Wikipedia's Izmir and Saudia pages still show it and appear stale.
_excluded.EVN: Yerevan - absent from Zvartnots' 82 destinations and from flynas's Summer 2026 network.
_excluded.JTR: Santorini - absent from Santorini's 56 destinations at peak season; flynas's last Greek-island flight was 29 Sep 2022. Wikipedia's Santorini page cites a 2023 booking-engine snapshot.
_excluded.KTM: Kathmandu - Himalaya Airlines' own July 2026 schedule notice shows no Riyadh service.
_excluded.TIV: Tivat - not listed among Tivat's nonstop origins.
_excluded.BGW: Baghdad - Riyadh absent from Baghdad's 18 nonstop origins; flynas's Iraq network is Madinah and Jeddah only. No evidence scheduled RUH-BGW ever operated.
_excluded.ALP: Aleppo - flynas announced for Aug 2026 (AeroRoutes 27 Jul 2026); not yet flying, and not yet in the Wikipedia table, so held until it starts.

frequency_note: Typical weekly frequency, read off the same sources used to verify the route and hand-checked one by one. Sampled 2026-07-31. This is how often the route runs in a normal week, NOT a timetable and NOT which days your flight goes -- use the live link for that. Routes without a figure here had none that could be pinned to the Riyadh route specifically.

CNN.note: 3 weekly to Riyadh (the 69 weekly in the source is Kannur's whole international programme, not this route)

HKG.note: increased from 4 weekly to daily from 26 Oct 2025

ATH.note: 3 weekly A320 plus 1 weekly A321XLR from 5 Aug 2026

JED.note: multiple daily; Riyadh Air plus Saudia and flynas

DXB.note: multiple daily across Emirates, flydubai, Riyadh Air and Saudia

CAI.note: daily or better across several carriers

LHR.note: Riyadh Air RX401/402 daily, plus Saudia

SAW.note: flyadeal daily, but the schedule filing is over a year old

MNL.note: Cebu Pacific, Philippine Airlines and Saudia combined

_frequency_excluded.IAD: Source contradicts itself -- '2 direct flights every week' alongside '3x weekly westbound'. Left out rather than pick one.
_frequency_excluded.AHB: The 127 flights/week figure is Abha's whole network, not the Riyadh route.
_frequency_excluded.MED: The 74 flights/week figure could not be pinned to the Riyadh route specifically.
